finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md:3).** 380 commits, 14 that a user notices.

The headline is three breaking changes nobody labelled breaking.

| Change | Why it bites |
|---|---|
| `stop re-exporting the internal error types` | 7 commits across `core` `db` `auth` `jobs` `billing`. Imports break. |
| `drop the unused v1 export route` | `src/api/router.js`. Unused by us, not by them. |
| `return 401 for an expired token instead of 403` | Wire behavior. Clients branch on this. |

One feature: webhook retry with backoff.

Two things to check. I guessed the release date `2026-08-29`. And six commits say `docs: note the minimum node version` with CI moving to node 22, but no `engines` bump. If the floor really moved, that is a fourth breaking entry.
